phase_name: Rename the override contracts and give the lean residue a home

objectives.description: Rename lean's four override files to domain-prefixed basenames
Rename cslib's orphaned override and add contracts to provides.context
Author lean4-sorry-discipline.md with sorry-inventory lifecycle, Zero-Debt policy, single-phase-focus
Fix core anti-analysis.md Domain Specialization bullet
Update lean's index-entries.json: rename rows, add row, on_demand, regenerate line_count
Add cslib-adversarial-verification.md row to cslib's index-entries.json
Confirm duplicate index paths are gone

notes: Scope Hypothesis confirmed exactly: 4 lean override files + 1 orphaned cslib file, 5 renames total.

Beyond the plan's explicit file list: fixed a Defect-B-shaped dangling reference in lean4-adversarial-verification.md (self) and mcp-tools-guide.md, both pointing at the old extension-namespaced path; removed a pre-existing stale cslib index-entries.json row for the old unprefixed basename that predated this phase; rewrote cslib-adversarial-verification.md's header narrative, which described the now-retired directory-merge clobber mechanism as still live.

Post-redeploy, the additive-only deploy copier left two stale artifacts behind that it never auto-removes: .claude/context/contracts/context-hygiene.md (orphan file) and its ghost row in .claude/context/index.json. Both removed manually per deploy-orphan-detection.md's documented detect-never-auto-delete design.

Full verify-deploy.sh run #1 (pre-redeploy): 7/42 failed. Triaged: 2 genuine (manifest-driven content-hash, orphan detection) fixed via redeploy + manual stale-artifact cleanup; 3 pre-existing/unrelated (eager-load budget, shellcheck, dead-command-recommendation) confirmed by direct re-run against files this phase never touched; 1 transient flakiness (test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh case r-a2/r-b) confirmed resolved on isolated re-run, attributed to resource contention with a concurrently-running sibling /orchestrate task's own verify-deploy.sh fixture processes.

Targeted re-runs of --only-gate 3,5,13 confirm clean. A second full verify-deploy.sh confirmatory run was launched as a detached background process and is being awaited across the phase 2/3 boundary; its result will be recorded before Phase 2's commit if it completes in time, otherwise in Phase 3's own verification.
